max_tire.note: Owners report no rubbing on half-tons, even aired down. 33x10.50s fit on factory rims. 33x12.50s fit a stock three-quarter-ton, but a half-ton will almost certainly need trimming (GMSquarebody).
Offroad Design's '88 Suburban ran these on 15x8 steel wheels with a 3 in front and 4 in rear lift, including Moab's slickrock trails.
BaT's Chinook Trail Boss V1500 runs 35x12.50 BFGoodrich tires on a 6 in Rough Country lift with ORD shackles. Plan on gears, steering bracing and brakes.

items.title: Brake pedal push-rod retainer clip may be missing
items.summary: Without the clip the brake pedal could disengage from the master-cylinder push rod. Dealers inspected and fitted the clip.

items.title: Platform trailer-hitch bolts under-torqued
items.summary: Hitch attachment bolts could loosen and break. Dealers repositioned the hitch, re-torqued it and replaced the hitch-to-frame bolts.

items.title: Driver's seat belt may not lock
items.summary: A new driver's seat-belt assembly was installed.

items.title: Transmission fluid forced out of the vent
items.summary: Heat could push fluid out of the vent tube. The fix was a longer vent hose routed to the left side of the engine bay.

items.title: Front brake rotor separation from road-salt corrosion
items.summary: Corrosion at the joint between the stamped center and cast outer section could separate the rotor. Rotors were replaced with coated parts.

items.title: Seat recliner bolts may loosen
items.summary: Foam or vinyl trapped in the recliner joint lowered bolt torque, leading to bolt fatigue. Dealers cleaned the joint and replaced the bolts.

items.title: Certain FRAM G3727 replacement fuel filters
items.summary: An equipment recall of aftermarket filters with 2005–06 date codes and Mexico origin marking. Check any spare filter of that type.

timeline.change: Rounded Line Suburban launches with four side doors, standard double rear doors and an optional tailgate with a wind-down window. K10/K20 4x4s use the NP205 or the full-time NP203. 307 V8 offered this year only
400 V8 added for K-series trucks. Trims become Custom Deluxe, Scottsdale and Silverado (GMC: Sierra Classic replaces Super Custom)
Quick-release third-row seat. Last year for the Estate woodgrain package
Full-time 4WD dropped; K-series go part-time. Last year of the 400 V8
Major facelift. NP208 transfer case with automatic locking hubs and shift-on-the-fly up to 25 mph. 700R4 overdrive automatic available
6.2 L Detroit Diesel V8 option. Three-quarter-ton trucks switch from 16.5 to 16 in wheels
Throttle-body fuel injection on all gasoline engines. C/K renamed R/V (R = 2WD, V = 4x4)
Largest facelift since 1973: flush, mostly black grille and a new steering wheel
Final year. Wikipedia says the 4L80-E replaced the 700R4; check the transmission on any given truck

identify.intro: Nineteen years, two brands, three transfer cases, half- and three-quarter-ton versions, and plenty of 2WD-to-4WD conversions: work out exactly what you're looking at before you price it.

items.head: Year by front end
items.body: Per Hagerty: 1973–80 trucks have round headlamps, a styled hood and vertical side markers; 1981–88 trucks have rectangular lamps, a flat hood and horizontal markers; 1989–91 trucks have four small rectangular headlamps (two on economy trims, per Wikipedia).

items.head: Model codes
items.body: C = 2WD and K = 4x4, with 10/20 for Chevrolet half- and three-quarter-ton and 15/25 for GMC until 1980. For 1987–91 the trucks are R (2WD) and V (4x4), badged 1500/2500.

items.head: True 4x4 or conversion?
items.body: Check for a factory front axle, transfer case and K/V designation. BaT has sold a C2500 Suburban with a 4x4 swap. Also, no factory 4x4 Suburban had a 454 per Chevrolet's 1982 and 1987 spec sheets.

items.head: Transfer case
items.body: NP203 (full-time, 1973–79): about 22–23 in long, four bolted sections, with a lock position. NP205: one-piece iron case, three-bolt idler cover, tag above the front output. NP208 (1981+): aluminum, chain-drive (Offroad Design, Wikipedia).

items.head: Diesel trucks
items.body: From 1982, 6.2 diesel trucks got their own fender and tailgate badging (Wikipedia). Diesels needed the B3J diesel equipment package per the 1982 spec sheet.

capability.note: 1982, gasoline 350 with trailering package. The 1973 brochure claims up to 14,000 lb combined for a Series 20
Wikipedia infobox figure; varies by series and equipment

values.intro: Still the cheapest way into a square-body 4x4. Prices are steady rather than rising, and a clean, rust-free original V1500 or an early K-series truck brings the most.
values.note: Based on 17 Bring a Trailer sales of mostly original 4x4 Chevrolet and GMC Suburbans, 2024–26 (median about $15,750; a 1973 Cheyenne Super Estate 4x4 reached $70,000), and Hagerty's guide (usable under $10,000, excellent $25,000–30,000).
